annotation.bound_parties_text: The practice is directed at those developing UAS software and users of the standard, who must establish appropriate safety and health practices.
annotation.bound_parties_quote: It is the responsibility of the user of this standard to establish appropriate safety and health practices and determine the applicability of regulatory limitations prior to use.
annotation.legal_effect_quote: This standard does not purport to address all of the safety concerns, if any, associated with its use.
annotation.robot_provision_quote: Standard Practice for Ensuring Dependability of Software Used in Unmanned Aircraft Systems (UAS)
